name: Tal the Wind Rider Master
summary: In Thunder Bluff, Tal the Wind Rider Master awaits a parcel from Ahanu. It is bound for Jahan Hawkwing at the Crossroads, linking Mulgore’s leatherworkers with Barrens merchants.

sections.title: Supplies for the Crossroads
sections.body: Ahanu, a leatherworker on Thunder Bluff’s lower rise, sends finished hides to Jahan Hawkwing’s trade stall at the Crossroads. Trade between Mulgore and the Barrens matters to the young Horde, but the journey down the bluffs and across the plains takes hours on foot. Winged couriers carry parcels over the divide.

sections.title: Master of the Mesa's Roost
sections.body: On Thunder Bluff’s highest central tier, Tal tends the city’s wind riders, also called wyverns. The winged beasts cross Kalimdor’s rugged peaks and shifting thermal drafts. Tal arranges flights to outposts such as the Crossroads, carrying messengers and cargo between the tauren capital and its orcish allies.

faq.answer: Tal tends Thunder Bluff’s wind rider roost on the central mesa. He arranges aerial transport for travelers and couriers bound for the Barrens and beyond.
Ahanu is a tauren leatherworker in Thunder Bluff. He prepares leather goods for vendors at Kalimdor outposts, including Jahan Hawkwing at the Crossroads.

faq.q: Why do the goods need to go to the Crossroads?
faq.answer: The Crossroads is a trade and military junction in the Barrens. Goods from Mulgore, including hides and leather garments, supply travelers, hunters, and Horde patrols there.

faq.q: Can I fly straight to the Crossroads with this parcel?
faq.answer: You can fly to the Crossroads after visiting the settlement and making contact with Devrak, its wind rider master. Until then, you travel overland on foot.
Wind riders, also called wyverns, are sentient, venomous winged predators native to Kalimdor’s crags. They allied with the Horde since the Third War and are its chief aerial mounts.

faq.q: Where does this courier errand lead next?
faq.answer: After you deliver the goods to Tal, he directs you to take Ahanu’s parcel across the plains to Jahan Hawkwing at the Crossroads.

angles.text: As a tauren, you rely on Thunder Bluff’s wind riders to connect your people with the wider Horde.
As Horde, you rely on flight routes between the Barrens and Thunder Bluff to carry reinforcements, trade goods, and messages across central Kalimdor.
